message.content:
**All‑time top scorer for the Los Angeles Lakers:**  
Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar – 38,387 points (1979–1989).

**Current season (2025‑26) top scorer for the Lakers:**  
LeBron James – averaging about 27.5 points per game (as of the latest box‑scores).
